subject: Private VPC architecture review \u0014 scheduling follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private VPC architecture review  scheduling follow-up

Alex  thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Run Redwood Private in a VPC-connected deployment (customer-controlled network) for production inference; evaluate networking, storage, KMS, and deployment automation.
- Key constraints you mentioned: strict egress rules, on-prem VPN for secure control-plane connectivity, and SOC2 evidence requirements.
- Suggested next step: 60	675 minute architecture review with our Solutions Architect (Marissa) and your network lead to walk through topology, firewall rules, and any integration constraints.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2028-12-05, 10:00	611:15
- Wed 2028-12-06, 14:00	615:15

If those don't work, send 2	3 times that do. Also please confirm the internal attendees (network/security engineer, cloud infra owner) and whether we should include a separate call for procurement/legal later.

Attaching a short prep doc that outlines the topics we typically cover and what information is helpful to have ready (network CIDR, VPN type, KMS approach).

[attachment: redwood-private-vpc-prep.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finapps.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@finapps.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review  scheduling follow-up

Thanks Aditya  great recap. We want to move forward with the architecture review. Wed 2028-12-06 14:00	615:15 PST should work for our team. I'll have Priya (products) and Carlos (network) join. 

Couple of items to note before the call so Marissa can prepare:
- Our network team requires an outline of outbound ports/protocols needed for the control-plane connection; we typically lock down everything except approved ranges.
- We use site-to-site IPSec tunnels for most customers; Carlos will confirm whether we can open a temporary SSH-forwarding port for initial provisioning.
- We will need a high-level statement of data flows for our security/compliance folks (what data crosses control plane, logs retained).

I attached a short internal network outline that shows current VPNs and CIDR blocks  Carlos will add detail on the call.

[attachment: finapps-network-outline.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

See you Wed 12/06 at 14:00 PST.
—Alex
Head of Product, FinApps Inc.
alex.johnson@finapps.com | +1 (617) 555-0098

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-12-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review  scheduling follow-up

Perfect  thanks Alex. We've locked the time: Wed, Dec 6, 2028 | 14:00	615:15 PST. I've created a calendar invite and included an agenda and pre-reads. Please find the invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-finapps-vpc-review-20281202T1700

Agenda (60	675 min):
1) Introductions & goals (5	10m)
2) FinApps current topology & constraints (Carlos) (10	15m)
3) Redwood Private architecture walkthrough (Marissa) (20	25m)
4) Control-plane/networking details: ports, tunnel setup, egress (Marissa + Carlos) (15m)
5) Next steps: procurement/eng handoff, SOC2 artifact queue (Aditya) (5	10m)

Attaching our architecture deck that covers typical VPC topologies, firewall rules, and KMS options. Marissa  can you confirm if we should prepare any specific configuration examples for IPSec vs. AWS VPN Gateway during the call?

[attachment: redwood-private-vpc-architecture-deck.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

If anything changes on your side, just reply to this thread and I'll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review  scheduling follow-up

Thanks  invite received and accepted. Carlos confirmed he can share the IPSec config template on the call and Priya will bring the compliance checklist items. If Marissa can include one slide comparing IPSec vs AWS managed VPN setup that would be helpful.

One last ask: can you include a brief note on expected timeline from signed order to production (ballpark), and any typical lead times for dedicated appliance or on-prem packages? We'll flag that for procurement.

Look forward to speaking next week.
—Alex
